scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: A request that should fail
scenes.caption: Asha tests a harmless offline portal model. One signed-in participant requests another participant’s record, and another request supplies a negative amount. The first draft relies on the interface to prevent both cases.
scenes.dialogue: Which server decisions must be explicit?

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Three different protections
scenes.caption: Input validation checks the allowed shape or range. Authorisation checks whether this identified actor may perform this action on this record. Safe data access keeps supplied values from becoming query instructions. One control does not replace the other two.
scenes.dialogue: A valid input can still request an unauthorised record.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Retain failing examples
scenes.caption: Keep an own-record case, a different-owner case, an invalid amount and an unexpected identifier. Run the draft, repair the specific controls and rerun the same cases. This toy model reports outcomes without executing any database query.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Repair the boundary
scenes.caption: A record identifier is well formed, but belongs to another participant. Does formatting make the request authorised? Choose the control that checks the actor’s permitted action on the requested record.
scenes.dialogue: Identity, validity and permission are separate facts.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: The repaired model
scenes.caption: The server checks a trusted session, enforces record ownership, validates the amount and uses structured data access. The corrected synthetic pack rejects unsafe requests while retaining the intended own-record path. Passing the pack is evidence, not a security guarantee.
scenes.dialogue: A repair must not remove the valid path.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the design lab
scenes.caption: Map misuse cases to controls, run the faulty and corrected model and test exact amount boundaries. Do not scan, exploit or send requests to a live service; every operation stays inside this lesson.
scenes.dialogue: Test the correction at the boundary too.
